column1:
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Mannar to Hambantota via Kankasanthurai, Trincomalee and Pottuvil. Showers or thundershowers
may occur at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from Colombo to Matara via Galle
in the evening or night.
Winds will be South-westerly or variable in direction. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.

The sea areas around the island will be slight.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
